topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I stumbled upon my old college application essay, posted online as a model for others. My heart sank as I read the words, recalling how many sleepless nights I spent crafting each sentence. I wondered if my admissions officers had always intended to share it. The thought of hundreds, maybe thousands, of strangers dissecting what I poured my soul into is overwhelming. I hope the insights it offers will help someone, but the idea that my personal reflections are now public leaves me uneasy, wishing I had written with that in mind.
